## Change and evidence

Describe the resulting behavior or dataset addition. Link original sources and dated license evidence. Identify the scoped files, counts and checksums actually verified.

## Checks

- [ ] Schema validation, tests and lint pass; results provided.
- [ ] Source links and licenses checked; unresolved checks marked unverified.
- [ ] No restricted corpus, private data, unapproved scraping or fabricated annotations.
- [ ] Hosted files have explicit redistribution rights, per-record provenance and attribution.
- [ ] Human review and AI involvement are accurately marked.
- [ ] Share-alike obligations and dataset-specific limitations documented.
- [ ] No files reach GitHub's 100 MB limit; no unapproved LFS use.

## Remaining work

List unknowns, review needs and release blockers. Do not claim v0.1.0 readiness unless all required checks and maintainer approvals are complete.
